dedupe_keys.name: ispra catasto rifiuti municipal waste production and separate collection for every italian municipality 2010 to 2024 and province 2001 to 2024

description: The Catasto Rifiuti gives, for every one of Italy's municipalities, how much urban waste is produced each year and how much of it is collected separately for recycling, the reference source for local waste performance in Italy. It is maintained by ISPRA, the national environmental protection and research institute. Coverage is every municipality from 2010 to 2024 and every province from 2001 to 2024. The files give population, tonnes separately collected by fraction (organic, green, paper and cardboard, glass, wood, metal, plastic, electrical equipment, textiles, construction and demolition, street sweeping, bulky waste and others), unsorted waste, total urban waste and the separate collection rate. One CSV per year covering all municipalities is available as a free download, and the navigation pages offer tables by region, province and municipality. Caveats: rounding means CSV values can differ slightly from the web pages, and treatment destinations are not part of these tables. Simulation uses: setting municipal waste generation and collection splits in waste collection and treatment network models, and comparing municipalities to test collection policies. Related records: the Italian municipal waste cost panel (data-italy-municipal-solid-waste-cost-panel) uses similar municipal data, and Eurostat municipal waste (data-eurostat-env-wasmun) gives national totals.
